# Support and community

- Start with the [installation chooser](https://ravhello.github.io/presence-bridge/setup/)
  and [FAQ](https://ravhello.github.io/presence-bridge/faq/).
- Ask setup questions or propose receiver ports in
  [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/ravhello/presence-bridge/discussions).
- Report a reproducible problem or tested hardware combination through the
  [issue forms](https://github.com/ravhello/presence-bridge/issues/new/choose).
- Disclose vulnerabilities privately through
  [Security Advisories](https://github.com/ravhello/presence-bridge/security/advisories/new).

Include versions, adapter model and observed behavior, but never real QR codes,
IRKs, Bluetooth/network addresses, credentials or full HA backups. Optional
iPhone support reports can be previewed before sharing. There is no guaranteed
response time; this is an independent community project.

The integration and receivers are MIT. The separate iPhone app is proprietary
and currently free during compatibility testing. Linux and unverified hardware
remain experimental. Please do not assume precise ranging or universal support.
